# The Spice House

> Premium online spice retailer offering 400+ curated herbs, spices, blends, and seasonings with 60+ years of expertise.

The Spice House is a leading e-commerce destination for high-quality spices and seasonings sourced globally. The site features curated collections organized by cuisine type, product format, and culinary use, complemented by expert recipes and gift options for home cooks.

## Key Topics

- premium spices
- spice blends
- seasonings
- herbs and spices
- cooking ingredients
- global cuisines
- gift boxes
- recipes
- Indian spices
- Asian spices
- African spices

- spice sets
- American classics
- beverage spices

## Core Collections

- [All Spices & Blends](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/all-spices-blends): Main catalog of premium spices and blends from around the world.
- [All Spice Blends](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/all-blends): Complete spice blends catalog featuring 60+ years of blending expertise.
- [Spice Sets](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/spice-sets): Curated spice value bundles with flavor pairings and savings.
- [Flatpack Refill Spices](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/flatpack): Flatpack refill collection with free shipping and resealable packets.
- [New & Unique Spices](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/new-products): New and unique spices from 400+ collection of herbs and seasonings.

## Culinary Uses & Specialties

- [Dips & Dressing Spices](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/dips-dressings): Dips and dressing spice blends for hummus, sour cream, yogurt.
- [Beverage Spices](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/beverage): Beverage spices for mulled wine, cider, hot cocoa, cocktails.
- [Food Toppings & Seasonings](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/toppings): Food toppings and finishing salts for garnishing and flavor enhancement.

## Global Cuisine Collections

- [American Classics](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/american-classics): Classic American regional spice blends and salt-free seasoning options.
- [Indian Spices](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/india): Indian spices including curry, garam masala, and traditional blends.
- [Southeast & East Asian Spices](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/southeast-east-asia): Southeast and East Asian spices for authentic Asian cuisine cooking.
- [African Spices](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/african-spices): African spices including Peri Peri, Ras El Hanout, and harissa.

## Gifts & Recipes

- [Spice Gifts & Gifts for Cooks](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/all-gifts): Gift boxes, gift cards, and curated spice gift collections for cooks.
- [Recipes](https://www.thespicehouse.com/pages/recipes): Expert recipe collection for everyday and special occasion dishes.

## Reference & Navigation

- [Alphabetical Spice Directory](https://www.thespicehouse.com/collections/letter-a): Alphabetical spice directory with ingredient guide from A to Z.
- [My Favorites](https://www.thespicehouse.com/pages/favorites): User account favorites page for bookmarking recipes and spice collections.
